items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: I didn't know that. No, no, no, I didn't mean deaf. But you see the trombone is a guest, a guest system. Yeah, that's right. You have to be exactly right. And George was so old, George was pretty old.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was a straight drummer. Oh he's a straight, just a straight drummer, you see.

He's still around, but he's just paid. No, he's paid. He used to be president of the local. Oh sure, I know the name of the local. Well he used to play, just to play the shows for Paul. And then after, anytime the new show come in there, he'd play the show for about two or three weeks until Paul got on to it, you see. Like that, I'd go enjoy it. You see. And then there were, during that time, Zutty came up and Joe said no, he wasn't ready to take and change. Now the only reason why he changed George Feely from…
Oh yeah, I didn't know. You see. Lost his feeling and all the parts.
